newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Arab Petroleum Investments says borrows $225 mln.
newsitem.headline: Arab Petroleum Investments says borrows $225 mln.

text.p: The Arab Petroleum Investments Corp (APICORP) said on Monday it had concluded a $225 million term loan facility, its first borrowing in the Euromarkets.

An APICORP statement said the facility would be used to finance future projects "in anticipation of increased demand for financing of oil, gas and petrochemical projects in the Arab region and beyond".
The statement said arrangers of the facility were Arab Banking Corporation, Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, J.P. Morgan Securities Ltd and Union Bank of Switzerland UBS UBS.S.S.
It said APICORP raised the loan to $225 million from $150 million because of strong interest from investors in Europe, the Middle East and Asia Pacific.
Established in 1975, APICORP is an affiliate of the Organisation of Arab Petroleum Exporting Countries. It finances oil and petrochemical trade and projects involving Arab states.
